import urllib.request, uuid
aid = '$ACTION_ID_0015bf329c0a043f4b42e60606eccd8657c1718bd7'
boundary = '----fx' + uuid.uuid4().hex
body = (f'--{boundary}\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="{aid}"\r\n\r\n\r\n--{boundary}--\r\n').encode()
req = urllib.request.Request('http://localhost:3939/', data=body, method='POST')
req.add_header('Content-Type', f'multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}')
req.add_header('Next-Action', aid)
req.add_header('Accept', 'text/x-component')
try:
    r = urllib.request.urlopen(req); print('OK', r.status); print(r.read().decode()[:400])

    print('ERR', e.code); print(e.read().decode()[:600])
